question: Which 5 shippers have the lowest total pnl among delivered loads?
generated_sql:
SELECT s.shipper_name, SUM(f.pnl) AS total_pnl
FROM loadsmart_dev.analytics.fact_load f
JOIN loadsmart_dev.analytics.dim_shipper s ON f.shipper_id = s.shipper_id
WHERE f.is_delivered = TRUE
GROUP BY s.shipper_name
ORDER BY total_pnl ASC
LIMIT 5;
